scientific_meaning: Mapped chronostratigraphic and lithologic unit providing regional thermal and host-rock geological context
normalization_method: Categorical one-hot encoding fitted strictly on training folds with explicit unknown token
missing_value_policy: Preserve explicit unknown category; do not impute unmapped areas outside northern extract
measurement_uncertainty: Mapping boundary uncertainty approx 100-250m; polygon boundary generalization error ~25m
licensing_status: RESTRICTED_REDISTRIBUTION (DMR terms unverified for derivative release)

scientific_meaning: Euclidean distance to verified active and regional fault traces indicating potential structural permeability conduits
data_source: DMR Active Fault Zone Database (630 lines)
normalization_method: Log1p transform (ln(1 + distance)) followed by training-fold robust Z-score standardizer
missing_value_policy: Mask as nodata outside mapped fault province; do not impute zero or median
measurement_uncertainty: Spatial error of fault trace ~50-200m; subsurface dip/blind fault uncertainty unconstrained
licensing_status: BLOCKED_REUSE (Catalog attribution conflicts with noncommercial clauses)
source_reference: DMR Active Faults (2016); Mordensky et al. (2025)

scientific_meaning: Ground surface elevation indicating regional topography and hydraulic head gradient
data_source: SRTM 1 Arc-Second Global (5 verified tiles: N17E099 N18E099 N19E098 N19E099 N20E099)
missing_value_policy: Strictly masked outside the 5 verified HGT footprints; no spatial extrapolation
measurement_uncertainty: Vertical absolute error < 16 m; relative error < 10 m

scientific_meaning: Local relative topographic position decomposing regional slope from local depression or ridge setting
data_source: SRTM 1 Arc-Second derived neighborhood (5 km radius)
normalization_method: Difference between pixel elevation and focal mean elevation; standardized on train folds
missing_value_policy: Masked outside valid SRTM tile extents; no extrapolation
source_reference: Caraccioli Salinas et al. (2024); Mordensky et al. (2025)

scientific_meaning: Topographic slope gradient affecting hydrologic runoff and structural outcrop expression
normalization_method: Robust scaling fitted strictly on training folds
missing_value_policy: Masked outside valid SRTM tile extents
measurement_uncertainty: Inherits SRTM vertical error and finite difference noise

scientific_meaning: Observed surface heat flow indicating terrestrial heat conduction
data_source: IHFC Global Heat Flow Database 2024 (154 rows at 111 coordinates inside Thailand)
normalization_method: NO NORMALIZATION OR INTERPOLATION PERMITTED; observation-only layer
missing_value_policy: Strictly unobserved; never interpolate across sparse distances without depth control
measurement_uncertainty: Measurement uncertainty unrecorded for all 154 Thai rows; depth unrecorded for majority
source_reference: Fuchs et al. (2024) IHFC; He et al. (2026)

scientific_meaning: Land surface radiometric temperature derived from thermal infrared remote sensing
data_source: USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Temperature
normalization_method: DN * 0.00341802 + 149.0 K with sensor QA cloud/shadow dilation masking
missing_value_policy: Mask all pixels failing Level-2 QA criteria; never conflate surface temp with reservoir temp
measurement_uncertainty: Radiometric accuracy ~1-2 K over homogeneous terrain; severe microclimate/vegetation bias

scientific_meaning: Bouguer gravity anomaly indicating deep crustal density variations and plutonic bodies
data_source: GGMplus ultra-high resolution gravity model (Southern Thailand research candidate)
normalization_method: Bandpass filtered and standardized on training folds
missing_value_policy: Nodata outside model grid; requires regional base station calibration
measurement_uncertainty: Inherent non-uniqueness of potential fields; forward modeling uncertainty ~2-5 mGal
source_reference: Hirt et al. (2013); Phiranram et al. (2026)

scientific_meaning: Total Horizontal Derivative (THD) of Bouguer gravity indicating deep density discontinuities and fault proxies
normalization_method: Projected Euclidean distance to THD ridge lineaments; log-transformed on train folds
missing_value_policy: Do not extrapolate; do not treat THD lineament as verified permeable fault trace
measurement_uncertainty: Potential field ambiguity; does not prove permeable fault conduit or fluid presence

scientific_meaning: Surface water temperature at geothermal manifestation spring orifice
data_source: GeoThermAI 47-record Master Manifestation Registry (published hot spring observations)
normalization_method: Ordinal classification or thresholding (e.g. warm vs boiling); never used as predictor feature
missing_value_policy: Missing for 2 northern and multiple provisional records; retained as unknown
measurement_uncertainty: Thermometer calibration uncertainty ±1-2 °C; seasonal dilution uncertainty unmeasured

scientific_meaning: Proximity to known surface manifestation in the label registry
normalization_method: PROHIBITED: Direct leakage of the target label distribution into model predictors
missing_value_policy: CRITICAL LEAKAGE: Never compute or pass to feature matrix during training or evaluation
measurement_uncertainty: Zero distance at label coordinates; causes 100% artificial accuracy and failure on holdout
source_reference: GeoThermAI Leakage Protocol; Mordensky et al. (2023)

scientific_meaning: Reservoir temperature estimated via chemical geothermometry (Na-K
canonical_unit: Literature geochemical surveys (Mendeley Kapong & published papers)
measurement_uncertainty: Thermodynamic validation checks; mineral equilibrium verification
licensing_status: Strictly missing where water chemistry is incomplete; never impute synthetic chemistry
source_reference: Model assumption error up to ±20-40 °C depending on mixing and re-equilibration
